Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates radiolucent streaks of air outlining the mediastinal structures (pneumomediastinum) and extending into the soft tissues of the neck and chest wall (subcutaneous emphysema), as indicated by the arrow. In the absence of tension physiology or esophageal perforation, these findings are typically managed conservatively with observation and rest.
